description.p: This is a community package of Zedis, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified.
Zedis is a Redis client written in Rust with the GPUI toolkit, built to stay responsive with large keyspaces.

ul.li: Browse and edit strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, streams, JSON and more.
Connect to standalone servers, clusters and sentinels, over TLS or an SSH tunnel.
Watch live metrics, analyse memory usage and run commands from a command palette.

description.p: The package has network access to reach your Redis servers, keeps the key that encrypts saved passwords in your desktop keyring, and has no filesystem grant: settings stay in the application's private per-app directory and exports go through the file chooser portal. It bundles Noto Sans CJK so Chinese, Japanese and Korean text renders on any host.
To use SSH keys for tunnels, grant read access to them: flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/.ssh:ro com.bigtree.zedis. Remove custom grants with flatpak override --user --reset com.bigtree.zedis.
